source_review.notes: Reviewed current PostgreSQL multicolumn, index-only, ordering, and scan documentation; official SQLite query-planning guidance; current MySQL 8.4 multicolumn/index guidance; Graefe; Chaudhuri-Narasayya; and the cited textbook. Five official destinations returned HTTP 200. Both MySQL and both Microsoft destinations returned automated-access HTTP 403; their official/primary content remained research-index readable. Product behavior is version scoped.
